verdict.rationale: Alerting is a fair axis for a cloud hosting platform, but the evidence pack contains no first-party documentation of alert rules or chat/email notifications. The only related items are adjacent: automatic Prometheus metrics collection, and users running their own monitors (Uptime Kuma, Betterstack). One user reported that their only alert during an outage came from a third-party monitor.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can set up alerts that notify me via chat or email when specific conditions are met
